tool_arguments.query: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Q3 FY2026 revenue growth

events.content: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Q3 FY2026 revenue growth

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (IaaS) revenue was **$4.9 billion in Q3 FY2026**, growing **84% year over year in U.S. dollars** and **81% in constant currency**. [[1]]

Sources:
[S1.1] Oracle - Oracle Announces Fiscal Year 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results — https://investor.oracle.com/investor-news/news-details/2026/Oracle-Announces-Fiscal-Year-2026-Third-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx

source_references.title: Oracle - Oracle Announces Fiscal Year 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results

tool_arguments.query: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure remaining performance obligations RPO FY2026

events.content: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure remaining performance obligations RPO FY2026

Oracle’s total remaining performance obligations (RPO)—the company-wide contracted backlog, not an OCI-only disclosed metric—ended FY2026 Q4 at **$638 billion**, up **363% year over year** and **$85 billion sequentially** from Q3. [[1]] 

During FY2026, reported total RPO rose from **$455 billion in Q1**, to **$523 billion in Q2**, **$553 billion in Q3**, and **$638 billion in Q4/FY-end**. [[2, 3, 4, 1]] 

Oracle did not report a separate OCI RPO balance in these releases; it said OCI demand was driving the backlog and, at Q1, forecast FY2026 OCI revenue of **$18 billion**, up **77%**. [[2]]

Sources:
[S2.1] Oracle - Oracle Announces Record Q4 and FY 2026 Results Driven by Cloud Infrastructure & Cloud Applications — https://investor.oracle.com/investor-news/news-details/2026/Oracle-Announces-Record-Q4-and-FY-2026-Results-Driven-by-Cloud-Infrastructure--Cloud-Applications/default.aspx
[S2.2] Oracle - Oracle Announces Fiscal Year 2026 First Quarter Financial Results — https://investor.oracle.com/investor-news/news-details/2025/Oracle-Announces-Fiscal-Year-2026-First-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx

tool_arguments.summary: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) IaaS revenue was $4.9 billion in Q3 FY2026, growing 84% year-over-year in USD and 81% in constant currency (source S1.1). Oracle's total remaining performance obligations (RPO) stood at $553 billion at the end of Q3 FY2026, a 325% YoY increase (source S5.1), and rose to $638 billion by FY2026 year-end, up 363% YoY and $85 billion sequentially from Q3 (source S2.1). Oracle forecast FY2026 OCI revenue of $18 billion, up 77% YoY, noting OCI demand as a driver of the RPO backlog (source S2.2). All figures are from Oracle's most recently reported fiscal periods (fiscal year ends May 31).
